headline: On November 19, 1994: First UK National Lottery draw held
captionCards: 1 in 14 million odds to win the first draw
Still running under new operator Allwyn Entertainment since 2024
instagramCaption:
The UK's first National Lottery draw took place on November 19, 1994.

A £1 ticket offered a one-in-14-million chance to match all six numbers from 49.

The event launched the state-franchised lottery, regulated by the Gambling Commission.

It was operated by Camelot Group until February 1, 2024, when Allwyn Entertainment took over.

Today, it remains a major part of UK culture and gambling history.
